title: New ways for fintechs to move money and expand globally
message_html: New ways for fintechs to move money and expand globally ...
snippet: We’re introducing three updates to help fintechs launch products and grow internationally more easily: simpler payout management with Stripe Global Payouts, support for stablecoin cards in more countries, and unified APIs for building global financial products.

title: Circle details USDC revenue split, says $819 million went to partners and costs in H1 2026
message_html: Circle details USDC revenue split, says $819 million went to partners and costs in H1 2026 ...
snippet: Circle breaks down its USDC revenue: about $1.4 billion in H1 2026, $819 million to partners and transaction costs, $473 million reinvested.
